title: GridLock
tagline: The social arena to prove your skill. Challenge rivals while your fans bet on your win.
description:
Social-Native Competition

Turns Talk into Action: We provide the first direct mechanism to settle online debates and skill-based claims right where they happen.
Community-Driven Stakes: It’s not just player vs. player; it’s community vs. community. Followers can financially and emotionally back their favorite creators, transforming passive viewership into active participation.
Content Generation Engine: Every challenge is a natural source of high-engagement content (live streams, videos, posts), providing a new vertical for creators to engage their audience.

The Technology Bridge: Seamless Web2 Integration

Frictionless Onboarding: Our browser extension is the key. It brings the dApp's functionality into the familiar Web2 environment of social media, eliminating the need for users to navigate to a separate platform.
Contextual Challenges: The "Challenge" button appears directly on user profiles, making the act of initiating a competition an impulsive and native part of the social browsing experience.
Viral Distribution Loop: Match pages are designed to be shared, leveraging the existing social graphs of the players to attract bettors and spectators organically.

The Web3 Mechanics: Trustless & Transparent Execution

Automated Escrow & Payouts: Smart contracts act as an impartial, automated referee. They hold all stakes and bets securely and execute payouts instantly and without bias once the result is verified.
Tamper-Proof Verification: We use a decentralized oracle network to report the off-chain game result on-chain. This removes any possibility of one party cheating or disputing the outcome, guaranteeing fairness.
Full User Sovereignty: All funds are handled directly through users' non-custodial wallets. We never take custody of their assets, ensuring complete security and user control.

Proof-of-Skill Reputation: Over time, every win and loss can be recorded on-chain, creating a permanent, verifiable history of a user's skill. This builds a new form of decentralized identity and reputation.
how_its_made:
The whole idea starts with a special browser add-on (an extension) we built. This is the magic piece. When you install it, it adds a "Challenge" button next to people's profiles on X . It was our first time building something like this, To build everything efficiently, we kept all our code for the browser add-on, the website, and all the behind-the-scenes stuff-in one highly organized monorepo. This just means we can build and update things much faster because everything is in one place.Instead of forcing you to create yet another new account, we simply let you sign in with your existing X account. It's quick, secure, and instantly links your social profile to your gaming challenges. To handle money and results, we use a special, super-fast and secure blockchain called the Flow blockchain.
Here’s what it does:
Keeps a Permanent Record: It stores a public, un-hackable record of everyone's wins and losses.
Holds the Money Safely: When you and an opponent bet, the money goes into this digital vault, where it's locked and visible to everyone. No one can touch it until the game is over.
Pays Winners Automatically: The moment the game ends, the "digital referee" instantly sends the money to the winner. It’s all automatic, so there’s no person in the middle who can make a mistake or delay things. It's 100% fair and transparent.
The trickiest part was getting our browser add-on, the social media site, and our secure payment system to all talk to each other instantly. We're particularly proud of how we made this complex process feel completely seamless for you, the user.
